Wabtec Corporation Opens New Headquarters in Pittsburgh. Wabtec Corporation announced the grand opening of its new headquarters in Pittsburgh. The company’s origins began in Western Pennsylvania with founder George Westinghouse Jr.’s invention of the automatic air brake – a breakthrough that redefined the transportation industry and saved lives. The office will house roughly 250 employees and play a critical role in accelerating the future of transportation.

Wabtec Corporation Reports Earnings Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2019. Wabtec Corporation announced earnings results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2019. For the third quarter, the company announced sales was USD 2,001.7 million compared to USD 1,077.8 million a year ago. Operating income was USD 169.1 million compared to USD 125.2 million a year ago. Net income was USD 91.1 million compared to USD 87.7 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share was USD 0.48 compared to USD 0.91 a year ago. For the nine months, sales was USD 5,831.6 million compared to USD 3,245.7 million a year ago. Operating income was USD 437 million compared to USD 380 million a year ago. Net income was USD 191 million compared to USD 260.6 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share was USD 1.17 compared to USD 2.71 a year ago. Diluted earnings per share was USD 1.11 compared to USD 2.7 a year ago.

Wabtec Wins Drill Motor Deal with Megha Engineering Infrastructure Limited. Wabtec and Megha Engineering Infrastructure Limited announced an agreement for 143 AC drill motors to support an upcoming onshore rig replacement project for Oil and Natural Gas Corporation. The deal will support ONGC in its efforts to replace their aging fleet of onshore drilling rigs. MEIL is leading the project to replace nearly half of ONGC's aging 67 onshore drilling rigs. The upgrade is a critical infrastructure initiative to increase crude oil production as part of ONCG's growth strategy outlined in Perspective Plan 2030. The new drill motors will give the onshore rigs, being made by Drillmec, the drilling power necessary to raise production levels.
